recorded.prompt:q-indices: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-indices: "sufficient_assumptions_for_infeasibility() returns variable indices, not names"; code maps flags[n].index back to row names.
recorded.prompt:q-check-set: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-check-set: "a program that reports conflicts must still check: run the deletion filter on the named set, which costs one solve per named row."
recorded.prompt:q-fewest: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-fewest: "Assumptions do not answer it. An objective does. Make every flag free, with no assumptions, and maximize the number of flags left on".
